title: Bertonio Aymara
notes: Digitised edition of Ludovico Bertonio's Vocabulario de la Lengua Aymara (Juli, 1612), distributed as a StarDict dictionary in the native-dics repository of Amos Batto. The text is not a diplomatic transcription: the orthography was modernised by Radio San Gabriel, and the dictionary was digitised by ILLA-A. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this edition, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
license_note: No LICENSE file in the repository (GitHub API: no licence), none in the README (it only gives GPL 3.0 for the Nusimi app, not for the dictionaries), and none in the dictionary .ifo file (which credits Amos B. Batto and says the orthography was updated by Radio San Gabriel and digitised by lenguandina.org/ILLA-A). Checked 2026-10-13.
institution: Ludovico Bertonio (1612); digitised by ILLA-A, orthography updated by Radio San Gabriel; packaged by Amos Batto (native-dics)
